objective: Connect project-owned native ingress without multiplying original tool bodies by the number of physical read sources.
requirements: Capture the complete configured project read boundary and stable selected write route; do not reconstruct it from latest heads during save.
Record each native event body once in its private ingress journal; attach the other sources' checked knowledge as bounded metadata.
Background source journals use one-hop references to immutable original journal heads and event ordinals, not copied bodies.
Project source knowledge without changing native occurrence, clock, Work, output or confirmed-delivery context.
Verify the original append chain before advancing a reference-import cursor; commit aliases and cursor together.
Retries cannot change the original event or its first observed knowledge; old pins stay old after append, corruption and process restart.
Preserve all three recommendation edges and explicit pending/unknown feedback; no recommendation gains Union or completed authority.
Do not add per-user or per-owner copies of canonical vectors; project-wide numerical preparation remains an explicit integration obligation.
Keep original publication, derived preparation and actual delivered context ACKs separate.
validation: Lean proofs for source-knowledge projection, original-body equality, bounded cursor progress; native event capture, multiple source views, large structured outputs, differential replay, retry, corruption and fresh-process recovery before ordinary-hook claims.
cleanup: Delete ended DBs/caches/raw logs/unused executables after compact evidence is sealed; no archives.
